description.text: The third and last expansion of the LEGEND series, released on 8 July 2010. True to its name it gathers legendary pairs as LEGEND cards, Kyogre & Groudon, Palkia & Dialga and Rayquaza & Deoxys, along with Great Pokémon such as Celebi and Machamp, and what the official site called attacks never before seen in the card game. Cards like the Supporter Black Belt change their effect with the number of Prize cards left. The cards are numbered to 80, with the fourth hidden Alph Lithograph as 081. The Black & White series followed on 18 September 2010. In English its cards were split between HS—Undaunted in August 2010, which took Kyogre & Groudon and Rayquaza & Deoxys, and HS—Triumphant in November 2010.
